name: BigRock
tagline: India's popular domain registrar with cPanel shared, reseller and VPS hosting
description: BigRock is a major Indian domain registrar and cPanel web host offering Linux/Windows shared hosting, reseller and VPS plans with long-term promo pricing.
about: BigRock is one of India's best-known domain registrars, also running cPanel-based Linux and Windows shared hosting alongside reseller and unmanaged VPS plans. Linux shared hosting is sold in four tiers — Starter, Advanced, Business and Pro — scaling up from a single-site plan to multi-site plans with more storage, email accounts and database allowances; Windows hosting mirrors this with Essential, Premium, Business and Pro tiers.

Entry-level Linux Starter pricing starts as low as roughly ₹69–159 per month when paid upfront on BigRock's longest available term (up to 5 years), and includes cPanel, a free SSL certificate and SSD-backed storage. A free domain is generally not bundled with hosting the way some competitors do it, so budget for domain registration/renewal separately.

As with most Indian hosting promos, the headline rate applies only to the first term — renewal pricing on BigRock plans typically runs two to three times the promotional rate, so it's worth checking the renewal figure shown at checkout before locking into the longest (and cheapest-looking) prepaid term. BigRock also layers in add-ons like CodeGuard backups, Cloudflare CDN and Varnish caching as optional upgrades on higher tiers.
policies: BigRock backs shared hosting, reseller hosting, cloud hosting and unmanaged VPS with a 30-day money-back guarantee: cancel within 30 days of a first-time signup for a full refund of hosting fees paid. The guarantee applies to first-time accounts only — renewals and auto-renewals don't qualify for a refund on any product, dedicated servers are excluded entirely, and the refund covers hosting fees only, not domain registration or other add-on charges.
